fusions.name: Misleading Buzz
fusions.desc: Sends a single feinting locust into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Kernel Stolen
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy at or below 25% health for 22 damage, adding 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it and consuming them. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Gone to Chaff
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds, moving 15% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Skimmed Off the Top
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you skim 6 mana from it. Once every 5 seconds.
